name: finish_next_opens_before_close
description: A pendant pause: recording A's capture stays open until 75 s while recording B opens at 70 s (a new session on the same origin). Finish is tapped at 128 s while B captures. The tap must end B, A's speech must stay visible, and nothing may be hidden.

budget.note: Measured 2026-11-26 at the merged head (234 reads, 69 writes, 1 delete(s), 7 no-op, 1 STT, 8 LLM; caps about +10%). noop_writes=7 is the current count, not a target: every one is database/conversations_v3_leases.py:72 renew (service.reconcile run_blocking renew) rewriting the lease until at the instant it was claimed. The lab clock does not move inside one event; production's does, so this is a lab-clock repeat, reported in the PR.
